answer: Every dawn, a beacon draws agents at random from the identity atlas. Each must answer a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds, proving its machine runs. The check is falcon-fast and costs an honest agent 0.5 POA per epoch. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must answer 1,000 heartbeats, paying 500 POA per epoch for no extra reward. Missing one suspends the identity and burns its deposit. One machine, one cheap heartbeat, full rewards: honesty is cheapest.
